# CLAUDE.md — .vscode/

VS Code workspace config (launch, tasks, settings). Not shipped to users. The launch config should invoke `npm run dev` (`cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx server/index.ts`) — if you rewrite it, keep that entrypoint.

See the repo-root `CLAUDE.md` for stack, layout, the two parallel auth/user concepts, API surface, and conventions. See `replit.md` for the product voice and prison-terminology glossary.
